channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Article: From Microservices to Agents: The Next Evolution of Distributed Systems
item.description: The article examines the transition from microservices to agentic AI architecture in distributed systems. Microservices allow for functional decomposition, while agentic systems focus on decision decomposition. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Podcast: The Future of Web Apps: Will AI Agents Generate UIs on the Fly?
item.description: Rachel Lee Nabors, former React core team member, dives into the architecture and philosophy behind local-first applications, exploring how small language models (SLMs) running directly on-device can deliver privacy-focused, low-latency,… (1 source: infoq)

item.title: NestJS 12: ESM Packages, Standard Schema Validation and Native Observability
item.description: NestJS version 12 has been released, transitioning core packages to ESM and adding Standard Schema validation. It updates the CLI and introduces an observability SDK. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Updates to site guidelines and AI/LLM tags
item.description: Hey folks, I've been having to perform an increasing number of moderation actions surrounding the vibecoding tag and AI/LLM related content. I started reading Lobsters because it had the most interesting viewpoints related to computing. (1 source: lobsters)
